remaining_costs: A 1-second macOS sample attributed 38% of constructor samples to scalar projection, 15% to counts, and about 15% to witness row clearing/copying. Compiled projection experiments did not provide a measurable net gain and were removed. Legacy hint arithmetic and all constraint/security parameters remain unchanged.

parallel_projection.submission: Existing WorkPool structured lease; fixed contexts, joined before cleanup or failure publication
parallel_projection.ownership: Immutable borrowed ProjectionContext; disjoint 32-row-aligned main ranges and logical metadata rows; private count histograms; coordinator merges only after the structured wave has joined; all histograms released before main commitment.

constructor_sample.stage: serial physical-order constructor before parallel projection
constructor_sample.interpretation: Projection classification and column stores dominate. The hint recipes were left unchanged because most sampled witness construction time was row clearing/copying. The separately compiled and fused recipe experiments did not provide a clear net gain and were removed.

parallel_interaction.prefix_storage: Existing five family prefix column slots temporarily hold row contributions; no additional wide intermediate
parallel_interaction.publication: Join every helper, scan logical prefixes, check expected state closure, then publish and retire metadata
